root_cause: The protected Production Source Snapshot workflow uses a shared concurrency group with cancel-in-progress:true. A newly pushed main commit cancels the authorized exact-source manual production deployment while it waits 180 seconds for native Git to converge. The newer push can be documentation-only; the applicability check previously compares only HEAD^..HEAD and misses older runtime code never actually published. 2026-10-19 forced run #39221955351 was cancelled by later main push #389cc824... while Netlify still published #d3a73d88.
prevention_rule: Never cancel an in-flight authorized Netlify source upload solely because a new main push occurs. Queue the latest pending reconciliation, and compare its full runtime change set with the last independently confirmed live commit; if provider state/ancestry cannot be verified, require a deployment instead of declaring no-op. Preserve exact-source/OIDC/merge/readback controls.
